# Manual demo

## What the plugin does

Shows pictures of your **cameras** in the portal. See [Setting up cameras](#setting-up-cameras).

## Setting up cameras

1. In GateControl: Gateways › Features › switch on Cameras.
2. Download `docker-compose.yml` and recreate the project.

### Camera settings {#kamera-einstellungen}

Switch on ONVIF.
